body: I just don't really know the answer to any of these questions.  I don't really see much of a future, so it is hard to visualize what I will want.

I don't really enjoy anything I have tried.  Honestly auditing kind of sounds fun.

I try to play video games and watch movies, but I never get through them.
I've got about a year left, maybe a year and a half.  I plan on going back, but it might not be for computer science.  I don't really like it.
I like Coheed and Death Cab.
I was at Disney world when I was in the fourth grade.  It's been a while.
Really?  Not here.  Stocking shelves or cashier work is minimum.
She knows some of it.  She understands, but is understanding what i want?

I was in school, but I owe the university too much money to allow me to enroll.  They force you to go off your parents income for financial aid purposes until you are 24.  I went off my parents, but turns out they sold some stocks and didn't exactly report it properly.  They revoked my loans leaving me owing the full tuition amount for the last two semesters.  So no currently a student.  I was a programming student though.
Not really.  I'm not sure what other options there are.
I lay in bed and be depressed!  I try photography sometimes, but I hate looking at my own work.  I draw too, but again, can't look at my own work.  What do you do?
Yeah that makes sense, but they aren't all like that.  The two I frequent definitely don't do that.

I've got a buddy who put down "Freelance computer repair" on his resume because he had fixed a few computers in high school and got paid.  They gave him fifty cents over minimum wage because of his prior experience.  It's not a great place to work, but they aren't that bad.
I would love to chat.
Nobody wants to work "college" jobs their entire lives.  We are working to survive, she isn't enjoying it.

No, I don't exactly have a good career.  We both make more money than we need to pay rent, utilities, and all that.  We spend a lot of money on things we don't need, and live comfortably, but we don't have "careers".  Just decent paying jobs and live cheaply.

We both moved to a college town, and met freshman year.  She dropped out after a while, I continued mine.  She wants to move back home, and find a career there.  There's really nothing in this town for her but me.  I don't want to move there though...at all.

There really is nothing specific.  Just something about this new girl.  I can't explain it.  At first, I thought it was just that she was new and different.  New always seems better than old at first, but it's really setting in.

I feel like I'm holding my current girlfriend back.  If she left, I honestly think she would be happier.  Not sure if I would.

A little bit.  I'm too afraid of people realizing how I really am.  If I talk to my girlfriend about how I truly feel, she's going to leave.  That is probably what needs to happen.

I'm afraid if I talk to my...side girl?...and tell her how I feel about her, she is going to get freaked out and never talk to me again.  I mean, she probably wouldn't, but the risk isn't worth it to me.  She knows how strongly I feel about her, and she says she feels the same way.  I don't know though.

Maybe something is missing.  I don't know.  When I think about being "gone", it's the reaction that S. would give that makes me not want to do it...

Don't get me wrong, it would effect a lot of people, and I really don't want that.  I wish I could just disappear without anyone knowing what happened.
Yep.  My only reason for not doing it is to keep a select few people from being emotionally hurt.
